chapters.fx: USD bid across the board; DXY 102.22–102.30, near 18-month highs.
chapters.meaning: The market is repricing toward a December hike under Chair Kevin Warsh.
numbers: FOMC minutes: 'most' saw another hike likely by year-end
FedWatch: Oct ~19%, Dec ~80% for a hike

scenarios.base: Fed holds hawkish tone into the Oct 27–28 FOMC; USD stays bid while Dec hike odds hold near 80%.
scenarios.bear: Soft CPI or a dovish FOMC surprise collapses hike odds; crowded USD longs unwind.
scenarios.bull: Oct 14 CPI beats expectations — Dec hike gets fully priced and DXY extends to fresh highs.

chapters.source: FOMC minutes / CME FedWatch / FRED via Reuters
chapters.title: The Fed turns hawkish

chapters.meaning: A fiscal risk premium is being priced into the euro on top of the rate-divergence drag.
numbers: French fiscal stress: widening spreads, Bank of France's Moulin in focus

scenarios.base: EUR/USD pinned near 1.12; French fiscal headlines keep a risk premium on EUR.
scenarios.bull: 1.1161 holds and fiscal fears fade — relief bounce toward 1.13.

chapters.title: Euro under pressure

chapters.fx: 159–160 is the resistance zone to watch.
chapters.meaning: Fundamentals are mildly JPY-positive, but the US–Japan rate gap still dominates price action.
numbers: Japan Aug current account surplus ¥4.062T vs ¥3.19T forecast
US Treasury (not the Fed) executed the US leg of Japan's late-July yen intervention

scenarios.base: Rate gap dominates; USD/JPY consolidates below 159–160 resistance.
scenarios.bear: US yields push higher — USD/JPY tests 160.
scenarios.bull: Risk-off escalation or dovish Fed repricing — JPY rallies, USD/JPY breaks lower.

chapters.title: Yen caught in the middle

chapters.fx: CAD bid via terms of trade; USD bid on risk-off flows.
chapters.meaning: A fresh supply-shock premium layered onto an already tight oil market.
numbers: Tanker strike off Qatar; Houthi attacks on shipping; Hurricane Isaias

scenarios.base: Supply-shock premium persists while shipping risks linger; CAD stays supported.
scenarios.bear: De-escalation — premium fades; Brent drifts back toward ~$100.
scenarios.bull: Further escalation — Brent extends gains; CAD bid, risk-off USD bid.

chapters.title: Oil spike

headline: A hawkish Fed, a pressured euro, and an oil spike lift the dollar to 18-month highs.
